services.title: Wedding Photography
services.subtitle: Your day. Your people. Your story.
services.shortDescription: Your wedding day is a collection of fleeting moments, quiet emotions, and people who mean everything. Preserve the feeling of your celebration through timeless photographs.
services.description: A wedding is not just a celebration. It is a collection of fleeting moments, quiet emotions, and people who mean everything. My approach combines honest storytelling with an editorial eye, preserving the feeling of your day in photographs you will return to for years to come.
services.philosophy: The most meaningful photographs are rarely the ones you plan. They happen in the glance across the room, the hand held a little tighter, and the laughter that arrives when nobody is watching.
services.heroAlt: An elegant wedding celebration captured in natural light
services.introAlt: A couple sharing an intimate wedding moment
services.idealFor: Couples who value genuine emotion, meaningful details, and timeless imagery.

services.title: Portrait Photography
services.subtitle: An honest expression of you.
services.shortDescription: Thoughtful portraits that celebrate individuality through natural light, meaningful composition, and an effortless photographic experience.
services.description: Portrait photography is an opportunity to see yourself from a different perspective. Through natural light, thoughtful composition, and gentle direction, I create images that feel personal rather than posed — photographs that reflect who you are, not simply how you look.
services.philosophy: You don't need to know how to pose or perform in front of a camera. The best portraits begin with a comfortable atmosphere, a little patience, and the freedom to be yourself.
services.heroAlt: An expressive portrait photographed in soft natural light
services.introAlt: A natural and expressive personal portrait
services.idealFor: Individuals, creatives, professionals, and people building a personal brand.

process.title: Understanding your vision
process.description: We discuss the mood, personality, and purpose you want your portraits to communicate.

process.title: Finding your style
process.description: We plan the location, wardrobe, lighting, and visual direction around you.

process.title: The portrait session
process.description: With simple guidance and a relaxed pace, we create space for natural expressions.

process.title: The final selection
process.description: Your strongest images are refined and delivered through a private online gallery.

relatedProject.title: In Her Own Light
relatedProject.imageAlt: A personal portrait captured in natural light
relatedProject.description: A portrait story exploring personality, confidence, and the beauty of individuality.

services.title: Editorial Photography
services.subtitle: Imagery with a point of view.
services.shortDescription: Distinctive visual storytelling for fashion, creative campaigns, and brands that want their imagery to communicate more than a product.
services.description: Editorial photography brings ideas to life through visual storytelling. From fashion concepts to creative campaigns, every frame is shaped by composition, atmosphere, and intention. The result is imagery with a distinctive visual identity and a story worth exploring.
services.philosophy: Great editorial imagery does more than show a product or a person. It creates a feeling, communicates an idea, and invites the viewer into a carefully imagined world.
services.heroAlt: A fashion editorial portrait with a distinctive visual style
services.introAlt: A fashion editorial photographed with artistic direction
services.idealFor: Fashion labels, independent designers, creative campaigns, and emerging brands.
services.duration: Planned according to the creative brief

services.title: Lifestyle Photography
services.subtitle: The beauty of being present.
services.shortDescription: Authentic photographs of people, places, and everyday experiences — captured with an observant eye and a natural approach.
services.description: Everyday life has its own quiet beauty. Lifestyle photography documents the interactions, environments, and experiences that make ordinary moments meaningful. The approach is natural and observant, creating photographs that feel lived-in, personal, and full of atmosphere.
services.philosophy: Not every meaningful moment announces itself. Sometimes it is the light entering a room, the familiar rhythm of a morning, or the people who make a place feel like home.
services.heroAlt: Warm sunlight falling across a beautiful natural landscape
services.introAlt: A peaceful landscape captured in natural light
services.idealFor: Families, couples, travel stories, everyday experiences, and lifestyle brands.
services.duration: Planned around your story and location
